components.name: R_Axial_DIN0207
components.notes: 330 Ω 1/4W through-hole axial resistor limits forward current to approximately 9.1–10 mA from a 5V DC supply with a typical 1.8–2.0V red LED forward drop ((5V - 2.0V) / 330Ω ≈ 9.1 mA).
components.physical_check: fits with warnings: The fab outline is 7.62 x 2.50 mm; Axial DIN 0207's body is 6.30 x 2.40 mm.

physical_spec.notes: Read Yageo CFR-25 dimensions on page 3 (DIN 0207 body 6.3x2.4 mm, lead diameter 0.55 mm); the bound horizontal footprint with 7.62 mm pitch fits this package when leads are formed.

source.reference: YAGEO CFR Series Datasheet, CFR-25 Dimensions

components.name: LED_5mm_Red
components.notes: Standard 5 mm red diffused through-hole indicator LED (typical Vf ≈ 1.8V to 2.0V, rated for up to 20 mA continuous forward current).
components.physical_check: no standard drawing to compare this land pattern with.

description: The 5V DC input rail is fed from header J1 (pin 1) through 330Ω axial resistor R1 to limit current to approximately 10 mA. R1 connects to the anode of red LED D1 (pin 2), whose cathode (pin 1) returns to the ground pin of header J1 (pin 2).

netlist.name: LED_ANODE
netlist.rationale: Current-limited connection from resistor R1 to LED D1 anode

netlist.name: GND
netlist.rationale: Ground return path from LED D1 cathode to header J1 pin 2

specifications.Candidate Components: Power Input Header: 1x02 Pin Header 2.54mm Vertical (PinHeader_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical) (Standard 0.1-inch pitch through-hole male header for 5V power input); Current-Limiting Resistor: 330 Ω 1/4W 5% Axial Through-Hole Resistor (R_Axial_DIN0207_L6.3mm_D2.5mm_P7.62mm_Horizontal) (Limits current to ~9.1-10 mA from 5V with 1.8-2.0V LED forward drop); Indicator LED: 5mm Red Through-Hole LED (LED_D5.0mm) (Standard red diffused 5mm indicator LED)
specifications.Constraints: Through-hole parts only; Nominal 5V DC supply rail; Target forward current approximately 10 mA; 2-pin 2.54 mm header input
specifications.Missing Requirements: Reverse polarity protection requirement; Header shroud/polarization preference
specifications.Risks: Reverse polarity on the input header can expose the LED to reverse voltage exceeding maximum rating (typically 5V); Supply voltage overvoltage above 5V could increase LED current and power dissipation

user_requirement: Design a simple 5 V LED indicator board: a 2-pin 2.54 mm power header, one current-limiting resistor sized for about 10 mA, and one red 5 mm through-hole LED. Through-hole parts only.
